summary: The day was dominated by job hunt automation work: investigating and ultimately abandoning xurl (X/Twitter CLI) due to a known headless OAuth2 bug and the X API free tier being write-only with no search capability. The Hunter.io cold email pipeline was built end-to-end — including HITL confirmation, email discovery, draft generation, and tracker status updates. A separate tech trends research report was produced covering AI, hardware, robotics, quantum, and cybersecurity domains.
highlights: Investigated xurl OAuth2 on headless Linux — confirmed broken upstream (PKCE flow requires browser redirect); decided to skip xurl entirely since X API free tier has no search anyway
Removed incomplete job-hunt-app xurl registration and cleaned up ~/.xurl
Built cold-email-outreach cron (ID: [REDACTED]) using Hunter.io API: reads tracker.md, finds verified emails, drafts tailored cold emails, delivers via Telegram
Implemented HITL flow: agent must confirm company/domain/role before spending Hunter.io API credits
Fixed bug where script ignored company argument and auto-picked wrong lead; rewrote to use a request file pattern
Tested pipeline successfully on MixRank and Enveritas; tracker status auto-updates (New → Researching) and pushes to GitHub
Portfolio project (mkhismkh.com — Next.js 16, Tailwind v4, Framer Motion) added to job-hunt cron context for design-eng applications

Produced tech trends report covering: agentic AI going mainstream, NVIDIA Blackwell/Rubin roadmap, AI coding assistants (30–55% productivity gains), humanoid robot factory deployments, post-quantum cryptography migration, and AI-vs-AI cybersecurity arms race
